title: Meituan Launches Full-Scenario AI Agent Platform CatPaw with Open-Source Large Model LongCat 2.0 of 1.6T Parameters

content_html:
On July 27, Meituan officially launched the CatPaw, an AI Agent platform powered by LongCat 2.0, marking its transition from technical open-source to industrial application for its self-developed trillion-parameter large model. As the newly open-sourced 1.6T total parameter model with native support for 1M ultra-long context, LongCat 2.0 is the first trillion-parameter model to complete full-process training and inference on 50,000 domestic computing cards.

CatPaw further transforms this underlying computing power and model capability into an enterprise-level intelligent workbench and agent development and management platform that is ready to use out of the box.

CatPaw deeply integrates Meituan's full-chain cognition in the local lifestyle sector, packaging expert and skill modules that are ready to use for scenarios such as store operations, review diagnosis, marketing conversion, and fulfillment delivery. The platform supports seamless collaboration between mobile and PC devices, 7×24-hour cloud-based long-term operation, cross-session long-term memory, and autonomous planning and execution capabilities, enabling multi-Agent collaborative processing of complex tasks.

In the enterprise segment, CatPaw Managed Agents provides an engineering foundation with strictly isolated operating environments, supporting cold start at millisecond level and dynamic scaling, and pre-installing multiple IM digital employee role templates. Currently, CatPaw has covered 90,000 employees within Meituan and successfully built over 30,000 agents.

Through the comprehensive launch from LongCat 2.0 open source to CatPaw, Meituan has completed the evolution path from "self-developed large models to all-scenario AI applications." This not only reflects the shift of large models from "being able to run" to "being effectively used," but also provides a scalable and practical reference model for the digital and intelligent upgrade of the local lifestyle industry.

content_html_zh:
7月27日，美团点评正式推出基于LongCat 2.0的AI Agent平台CatPaw，标志着美团自主研发的万亿参数大模型从技术开源转向产业应用。 作为最新开源的原生支持1M超长上下文的1.6T全参数模型，LongCat 2.0是首个在5万张国产计算卡上完成全流程训练和推理的万亿参数模型。

CatPaw进一步将这种底层计算能力和模型能力转化为开箱即用的企业级智能工作台和代理开发和管理平台。

CatPaw深度融合了美团在当地生活方式领域的全链条认知，包装专家和技能模块可用于店铺运营、评论诊断、营销转化、履约交付等场景。 该平台支持移动端和PC端无缝协作、7×24小时云端长期运行、跨会话长期记忆以及自主规划和执行能力，实现多Agent协同处理复杂任务。

在企业领域，CatPaw Managed Agents提供严格隔离的运行环境的工程基础，支持毫秒级冷启动和动态扩展，并预装多个IM数字员工角色模板。 目前，CatPaw已覆盖美团内部9万名员工，并成功建立了3万多个代理商。

通过从LongCat 2.0开源到CatPaw的全面上线，美团完成了从“自研大模型到全场景AI应用”的演进之路。 这不仅体现了大模型从“能跑”到“能有效用”的转变，也为当地生活方式产业的数字化、智能化升级提供了可扩展、实用的参考模型。
